name: lightaskd
description: Explicit-invocation-only local SQLite task ledger for AI agents.

interface.longDescription: Register, find, and update personal tasks in a local SQLite ledger, only when the user explicitly invokes the skill. No daemon, no notifications, no automatic execution.
defaultPrompt: $lightaskd register this Slack thread as a task in ./private-tasks with a Friday deadline.
$lightaskd find open tasks about authentication in ./private-tasks.
